comments.value: I would love this, when playing in VR, you can still interact with the physical keyboard and the character will still move, and I feel like if there is an option to change mode in the game without restarting the game would actually be nice.
so.... this would still be nice to have, especially for world development as getting in and out of vr is still an absolute nightmare.
Ive noticed that COVR has this feature and would be neat to see in vrchat too.
It is really inconvenient having to restart the app when I decide to get in VR and when my headset battery runs out.
2018 post and yet here we are
I joined a rave on desktop after waiting an hour in queue, now I want to switch to VR, but if I restart VRchat I'll loose my spot and never get back in... really sucks
When this finally drops in 2030 people will rejoice!

this would be pretty cool. I know it gets varied reactions of bleh from people to mention resonite, but it's neat that they can handle switching back and forth gracefully. it might be difficult to implement, but it also might not.
Joined an instance on desktop after leaving VR to charge trackers, instance has a queue and a seamless switch back into VR would be great.

details:
I only use it on the desktop, but I will make this proposal as full tracking friends have taken troublesome steps to comply with the world's specifications.
Can I switch between full tracking, VR, desktop mode in the menu?
By allowing them to switch, friends can quickly unify the environment and play the game world.
Or quickly respond to the world's gimmicks that can not be handled with full tracking.
After the controller's battery runs out, you can seamlessly switch to the desktop and enjoy the rest of the time.
title: Full tracking VR <> VR <> Desktop, seamless mutual switching in the game.
